_note: RegionDINO, object-only mode: NO whole-image views; the DINO loss runs only on object views cut around label-free regions (3 per image). Shared keys live in SARDet/shared/ssl_common.json (the scene view sizes there are unused here). The dino / optim sections equal DINO_SARDet/config_ssl.json.

object_views._note: windows are sized from each region's own extent (no fixed pixel size); max_magnification stops tiny blobs being blown up; region_source random = the control with matched-size random windows

_note_pool: Same method, same recipe, on the ATRNet-STAR SSL pool of the split (A1's pool) instead of SARDet scenes: the in-domain test of the object views. Views are cut from the chip resized to 224; regions proposed at the native 128 (rssl/pools.py).
